title: Mettukudi
desc: A man pretends to be the son of a long-lost royal family to steal a precious sword. However, his plan runs into complications when the granddaughter of the sword's guardian falls in love with him.

title: Neethaane En Ponvasantham
desc: Varun and Nithya's childhood romance is cut short when they pursue different paths in life. Years later, fate reunites them and Varun sets out on a heartfelt journey to win back the love of his life.

title: Poonthotta Kaavalkaaran
desc: A man unwittingly offers shelter to a couple running away from the girl's father, who is out for blood. However, the man does not realise the girl is his sworn enemy's daughter.

title: Nootrenbadhu
desc: A doctor diagnosed with cancer returns to India. There, he meets a journalist who slowly falls in love with him.

title: Yennai Arindhaal
desc: Sathyadev, an honest police officer, is on a mission to stop an organ trafficking racket, unaware that the mastermind is the same person who killed his beloved.
